name: DMD 4075
title: Senior Project
description: Development of a project in the student's area of concentration that demonstrates vigorous and consistent thematic engagement and articulates both technical and conceptual sophistication. To be taken twice in two consecutive semesters in the student's senior year. To fulfill the graduation requirement for B.F.A., students must pass with a grade of C or better. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open to senior B.F.A Digital Media and Design majors only.
